outline:
1.Using ADFT 16nm FinFET and/or CIC18 with EDA tools
2.Introduction to Deep Neural Networks
3.Design of Hardware for Processing DNNs
4.ADC Designs
schedule:
week  1      Introduction to Deep Neural Networks
week  2-4    Overview of Deep Neural Networks
week  5-6    Key Metrics and Design Objectives
week  7-8    Kernel Computation
week  9      Mid-term exam or Mid-term project
week  10-12  Designing DNN Accelerators
week  13     Integrating Converters
week  14     Flash Converters
week  15-17  Successive-Approximation Converters
week  18     Final exam or Final project
Note 1: The above weekly schedules are subject to change without further notice.
Note 2: Laboratory sessions will be provided to strengthen practical hands-on skills.

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查(Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
線上數位教材學習(Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
flexible_learning.content: If Final exam is given, students need to take part in the closed-book exam and scores will be given based on the students' performance. If Final project is given, students need to use the EDA tools to complete the project's requirements, which may include schematic design, layout drawing, pre-layout simulation, and post-layout simulation. Similar to the Exam scenario, scores will be given based on the performance of each student's design and simulation results.

assessment:
Attendance: 20%
Homework: 20%
Mid-term exam or Mid-term project: 30%
Final exam or Final project: 30%
